policies.title: Invoice questions
policies.text: For a missing invoice, ask for the order reference and purchase date. Do not ask for full card details, bank passwords, or payment credentials. The billing team will investigate after receiving those details.

policies.title: Account access
policies.text: For a forgotten password, direct the customer to the official application's Forgot password option. Never request passwords or one-time codes. Suspected account compromise requires escalation to security.

policies.title: Technical troubleshooting
policies.text: For an application error, ask for the error message, application version, and reproduction steps. Suggest restarting the application once. Do not request logs containing secrets. Do not promise a fix date.
